{{Hatnote|1=Transcript of a 1996 Decipher television commercial.}}
'''Star Wars CCG – TV Ad (1996)''' is a 31-second Decipher television commercial for the [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]], released in February 1996. Most of the spot is music over footage; the voice-over closes with the tagline "the galaxy in a box".

Source: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IXsMeCs8sZo Star Wars CCG - TV Ad (1996)], Lusco-fusco, YouTube (uploaded 14 December 2020).

''The text below is from the video's automatic captions, corrected; it has not yet been checked against the audio. The opening seconds of the voice-over are not in the captions.''

== Transcript ==
'''[00:13]''' [Music]

'''[00:23] Narrator:''' [unclear] Then buckle up, because this set's ready to play: Star Wars Customizable Cards. The galaxy in a box.

'''[00:28] Narrator (disclaimer):''' Feature cards are sorted randomly.
